name: Lithuania — Lithuanian parties
intro: compare it with Lithuanian political parties
inclusion_note: The test includes the main national parties of Lithuania: those represented in the parliament (Seimas) and those with a significant national following. Positions are the team's estimates and are open to review.
hemicycle_note: Seats in the parliament (Seimas) after the 2024 election, arranged left to right. Approximate. 141 members. Parties shown without seats are included because they poll strongly.

LSDP.name: Lietuvos socialdemokratų partija
LSDP.priorities: Welfare state, Public healthcare, Defence and support for Ukraine
LSDP.description: Social Democratic Party, the clear winner of the 2024 election and leader of the government.

DSVL.name: Demokratų sąjunga „Vardan Lietuvos“
DSVL.priorities: Welfare state, Regions and rural services, Pensions and the elderly
DSVL.description: Union of Democrats 'For Lithuania', a centre-left party of former prime minister Saulius Skvernelis.

LVŽS.name: Lietuvos valstiečių ir žaliųjų sąjunga
LVŽS.priorities: Farmers and rural areas, Traditional family values, Pensions and the elderly
LVŽS.description: Farmers and Greens Union, agrarian and socially conservative, with left-leaning economics.

Volt.name: Volt Lietuva
Volt.priorities: Deeper European integration, Climate action, Digital innovation, Democratic reform
Volt.description: National chapter of Volt Europa, the first pan-European party. All chapters share one programme: a federal and more democratic EU, evidence-based policy, a market economy with a strong welfare state, and the digital and climate transitions. Volt has the same positions in every country in this test.

LP.name: Laisvės partija
LP.priorities: Civil liberties, Education, Deeper European integration
LP.description: Freedom Party, socially liberal, which campaigned for same-sex partnerships and drug decriminalisation; it lost its seats in 2024.

LS.name: Liberalų sąjūdis
LS.priorities: Competitiveness and growth, Fiscal discipline, Civil liberties

TS-LKD.name: Tėvynės sąjunga – Lietuvos krikščionys demokratai
TS-LKD.priorities: Defence and support for Ukraine, Deeper European integration, Fiscal discipline
TS-LKD.description: Homeland Union – Christian Democrats, the main centre-right party, hawkish on Russia.

NA.name: Nemuno aušra
NA.priorities: Cost of living, Fighting corruption, National sovereignty
NA.description: Dawn of the Nemunas, a national-populist party founded in 2024 by Remigijus Žemaitaitis that came third in its first election and joined the government.
